title: Deer holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Deer body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="72" rx="20" ry="16" fill="#C68B59"/>
  <!-- Body highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="68" rx="12" ry="8" fill="#D9A76C"/>
  
  <!-- Deer head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="42" rx="14" ry="15" fill="#C68B59"/>
  <!-- Head highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="38" rx="8" ry="9" fill="#D9A76C"/>
  
  <!-- Ears -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="30" rx="5" ry="8" fill="#C68B59" transform="rotate(-20 36 30)"/>
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="30" rx="5" ry="8" fill="#C68B59" transform="rotate(20 64 30)"/>
  <!-- Ear inner -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="30" rx="3" ry="5" fill="#E8B88A" transform="rotate(-20 36 30)"/>
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="30" rx="3" ry="5" fill="#E8B88A" transform="rotate(20 64 30)"/>
  
  <!-- Antlers -->
  <path d="M42 30 Q38 18 32 14" stroke="#A0714A" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M38 22 Q34 18 30 20" stroke="#A0714A" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M58 30 Q62 18 68 14" stroke="#A0714A" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M62 22 Q66 18 70 20" stroke="#A0714A" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx="44" cy="40" r="3" fill="#3A2A1A"/>
  <circle cx="44" cy="39" r="1" fill="#F5E6D0"/>
  <circle cx="56" cy="40" r="3" fill="#3A2A1A"/>
  <circle cx="56" cy="39" r="1" fill="#F5E6D0"/>
  
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="48" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#5C3A1E"/>
  <!-- Nose highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="49" cy="47.5" rx="1.5" ry="1" fill="#8B6240"/>
  
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d="M47 52 Q50 55 53 52" stroke="#8B6240" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Front legs holding heart -->
  <path d="M38 75 Q32 65 35 58" stroke="#C68B59" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M62 75 Q68 65 65 58" stroke="#C68B59" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Heart -->
  <path d="M50 62 
           C50 56 42 54 42 59 
           C42 63 50 70 50 70 
           C50 70 58 63 58 59 
           C58 54 50 56 50 62Z" 
        fill="#FF4466"/>
  <!-- Heart highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="46" cy="59" rx="2.5" ry="2" fill="#FF7799"/>
  
  <!-- Hooves -->
  <circle cx="35" cy="58" r="3.5" fill="#5C3A1E"/>
  <circle cx="65" cy="58" r="3.5" fill="#5C3A1E"/>
  
  <!-- Back legs -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="86" rx="5" ry="4" fill="#A0714A"/>
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="86" rx="5" ry="4" fill="#A0714A"/>
  
  <!-- Tail -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="88" r="3" fill="#E8B88A"/>
  
  <!-- Belly light patch -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="76" rx="10" ry="7" fill="#E8B88A"/>
</svg>
